snippet.title: INTUS — Demo Trailer | First-Person Psychological Horror
snippet.description:
Wishlist INTUS on Steam:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/4699020/INTUS/

A normal apartment. One impossible night. INTUS is a first-person psychological horror game about routine, silence, and the moment paranoia stops being irrational.

Follow development: https://x.com/NMPrototypes
A game by Nahuel Martínez
